title: EU gas supplier replacement and Russian crude trade redirection

measurements.metric: EU natural gas imports by supplier, pipeline and LNG combined
measurements.unit: billion cubic metres per calendar year
measurements.method: European Commission calculations based on LSEG (Refinitiv) and ENTSO-G
measurements.scope: EU-27; all natural gas, not LNG-only
caveats: 2021 Russia figure is approximate; 2025 36 bcm rounded
Different data vintage and method from ECA 2021–2024 dataset; don't splice without reconciliation
EU gas demand declined over 19% 2021–2024, so not all reduced Russian volume was replaced
US gas receipts, net profit and domestic costs not measured

measurements.metric: Russian crude oil and condensate export destination
measurements.unit: million barrels per day and percent share
measurements.method: EIA analysis based on Global Trade Tracker, Argus and Vortexa
measurements.scope: Russian crude and condensate, not all petroleum products
caveats: Europe category includes Türkiye; not EU-only
China and India volumes are estimates, not Russian net receipts
Shifting export destinations does not demonstrate sanction-free trade or equal pricing

measurements.metric: U.S. LNG exports to Europe (EU-27 plus UK)
measurements.scope: EU-27 plus UK; not identical to EU-only import figures
caveats: Do not combine directly with EU-only bcm series
Export destination not company realized margin
2022 price surge influences export revenue independently of volumes

deduplication: Russian gas 2021–2024 series from prior PR remains separate due to source methodology; repeated workstream links count once
